You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.

My child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。

这将引发一场战斗！

成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。
texts.en:
Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.

This will start a battle!

 Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.

label.zh: 战胜运输船队后3天：普通战利品（权重70，前哨×0.2）
label.en: Won the fight: 3 days later, ordinary loot (weight 70; ×0.2 for outposts)

label.zh: 战胜后3天：活体货物（权重5，只出现一次，+1进度）
label.en: Won the fight: living cargo (weight 5, once, +1 progress)

label.zh: 战胜后3天：幽灵船（权重15，只出现一次，+1进度）
label.en: Won the fight: ghost ships (weight 15, once, +1 progress)

label.zh: 战胜后3天：医学之谜（权重10，只出现一次，+1进度）
label.en: Won the fight: medical mystery (weight 10, once, +1 progress)

label.zh: 战胜后7天：女王警告（已破解通讯频段则不会；5年内最多一次）
label.en: Won the fight: 7 days later her admonition (not after the comm scrambler 9000; at most once per 5 years)

label.zh: 被运输船队击败后7天：女王训斥，伏击项目重新开放
label.en: Lost the fight: 7 days later her scolding; the ambush project reopens

texts.zh:
随着塞塔娜在星系中现身，这个宇宙仿佛也在轻声回应。信标像在黑暗中燃烧着的火焰一般照亮了天空，在万古之间重复着恳求：

我们在这里……我们在这里……

我们在这里。

这些微弱的信号与塞塔娜的通信协议相同，表明它们的共同起源，但我们的传感器暂未发现它们附近有其他活动。肯定有什么存在是我们的扫描仪探测不到的。真有人能预料到她的归来吗？
texts.en:
As Cetana makes herself known around the galaxy, the cosmos whispers in reply. Signal beacons light up the skies like flames burning in the dark, repeating a plea across the eons:

We are here... We are here...

We are here.

The dim signals use Cetana's same communication protocols, hinting at a common origin, yet our sensors revealed no other activity in their proximity. There must be something there our scanners are not detecting. Could someone truly have anticipated her return?

label.zh: 空信标（1座，较大星系另加1–4座；可选）
label.en: Empty beacons (1, plus 1–4 on larger galaxies; optional)

label.zh: 四座真正的信标（任意顺序，各300天，需调查船）
label.en: Four real beacons (any order, 300 days each, science ship)

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
在[fromfrom.GetName]上发现的那座信号塔非常古老，我们甚至不敢碰它一下。构成它的金属早已脆弱不堪，仿佛轻轻一碰就会把那种能勉强维系着这团尘埃和希望的东西破坏掉。我们的仪器没有发现任何其他的人工制品、生命迹象，在它附近没有任何地形异常。

信标就这么孤零零地矗立着，发出微弱的呼唤，但应该发出这些信号的东西肯定早就不复存在了。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [fromfrom.GetName] is so ancient we dare not touch it, the metal so brittle a single tap would destabilize whatever tangle of dust and hope still holds it together. Our instruments detected no other artifact, no life sign, no topographical anomaly in its immediate proximity.

The beacon stands alone, murmuring its faint call, but whatever was supposed to signal must be long gone.

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

label.zh: 4号信标星球：不可能的幸存者
四座真正的信标全部调查完毕后15天（无论哪个最后完成）
label.en: 15 days after all four real beacons have been investigated (whichever finishes last)

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家轻而易举地就翻译了出来，它和在先知扎克兰的墓穴中找到的文字是同一种语言。

“请向女王的使徒降下死亡。”
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists easily translated it, matching the language to the writing found in the tomb of the prophet Zarqlan.

"Death to the Queen's Apostles, enemies of life."

texts.zh:
我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。

那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。

在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。我们的科学家正在紧锣密鼓地进行翻译，但不知为何他们猜测着可能是对某种死亡的祈求。
texts.en:
On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.

There was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.

On the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon. Our scientists are struggling to translate its exact meaning, but somehow they doubt it to be a prayer for the dead.

texts.zh:
成千上万的冷冻仓静静地躺在这颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，信标指示着它们的存在。这些冷冻仓非常复杂，使用了未知的合金，并装有非常先进的传感器，密切地监视着其中储存的生物。整个设计天衣无缝，但里面的生物无一生还。

这些东西并不是因为技术故障才变成的棺材，而是因为能源不足。随着[this.solar_system.GetName]的逐渐老化和变暗，它的能量输出不足以继续维持这座结构的运转。

这些冷冻仓虽然事为了运作到永恒而设计的，但它以外的宇宙可没有这么精密。
texts.en:
Thousands upon thousands of cryogenic pods rest under the surface of the [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], their presence marked by the beacon. The pods are highly sophisticated, built with unknown alloys and equipped with state-of-the-art sensors to closely monitor their occupants. There is no flaw in their designs, yet none of the occupants are still alive.

It wasn't a technical failure that turned this chamber into a mass grave, but a lack of energy. As [this.solar_system.GetName] got older and dimmer, its energy was no longer enough to keep the structure operational.

The pods were made to last forever. The rest of the universe isn't built that well.

texts.zh:
初步扫描未能发现[fromfrom.GetName]有任何异常；但当我们将注意力向下集中时，我们发现了一层不寻常的地下金属层。

进一步的结构分析揭示了[fromfrom.GetName]的真实本质：这颗天体不是一颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]，而是一艘逐渐被星系的岩石和尘埃所吞没的古老宇宙飞船。我们对钻探取得金属样本进行定年发现其非常古老，甚至比我们自己的母星形成还要早。

我们无法确定任何关于这艘船和它制造者的信息，也不知道它的功能，但有一件事是肯定的：我们在它的残骸中发现的失效核弹可不是为了什么和平使命而建造。
texts.en:
Preliminary scans did not show anything unusual on [fromfrom.GetName]; but as we focused our attention downward, we discovered an unusual, subsurface layer of metal.

Further structural analysis revealed [fromfrom.GetName]'s true nature: the celestial body is not a [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], but an ancient spaceship that has been gradually subsumed by the rocks and dust of the system. The metal samples we drilled are so old, they precede the formation of our own home planet.

It is impossible to determine anything about the ship, its makers and its function, but one thing is certain: the inert nuclear bombs we found in its remains weren't built for a peace mission.

texts.zh:
根据冷冻仓上显示的细节，这位外星人的名字叫埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。她已经在这里围绕着恒星公转了3兆2132亿1329万3124圈。这个冷冻仓本身只是我们在[fromfrom.GetName]地表之下的一个密室里找到的许多冷冻仓之一。埃里克的冷冻仓在克服种种困难的情况下依旧保持者运转。

尽管使这位外星人陷入休眠状态的子例程最近已停止运行，但它仍处于假死状态。从那以后，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克就一直处于部分有意识的状态中。

通过扫描她的脑电波，我们可能能够进一步了解关于这位不可思议的古老生物的信息，以及她与塞塔娜有何联系。
texts.en:
According to the details displayed on their cryopod, the alien's name is Elik Narith Kerak and she has been here for 3,213,213,293,124 stellar rotations. The pod itself was one of the many we recovered in a sealed chamber under [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface. Against all odds, Elik's pod remained functional.

The alien remains in a state of suspended animation, although the subroutines keeping it dormant have recently ceased their operation. Elik Narith Kerak has been partially conscious ever since.

By scanning her brainwaves, we might be able to learn more about this impossibly ancient creature, as well as her connection to Cetana.

title.zh: 塞塔娜：不可能的幸存者

texts.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
texts.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

sections.zh: 埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。
sections.en: Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

texts.zh:
我们的团队交过来了一大批通过对埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的脑电波进行采样构建出的影像片段：

片段1：
绿绿的天上飘着朵朵橙云。一只苍白的双手举起，指向了一头悠悠飘在空中的无定型生物。

片段2：
这是一间挤满了四臂类人生物的拱形大堂。他们围绕在一位身着长袍的人周边，倾听着。她的话语含糊不清，确切的措辞早已被遗忘，但她温柔的声音仍然记忆犹新，用爱的接纳温暖着整个礼堂。

片段3：
同样是那间拱形大堂，里面一片狼藉，吊灯在地上摔得粉碎。长椅抵挡在大门上，激光步枪的幽光在黑暗中闪烁，他们异口同声地诅咒着同一个名字：扎克兰！他们说，扎克兰和他的门徒是来毁灭我们的。守住防线！保卫女王！随着一声巨响，最后一盏灯落下了，房间陷入一片黑暗。远处，有人在黑暗中啜泣着。

片段4：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
Our imaging team has delivered a batch of video clips created by sampling Elik Narith Kerak's brain waves:

CLIP 1:
A green sky dotted by bright orange clouds. A pale hands reaches up, pointing at an amorphous creature softly floating in the sky.

CLIP 2:
A vaulted chamber full of four-armed humanoids. They cluster around a robed figure, listening. Her words are a mere mumble, the exact wording long forgotten, but the gentleness of her voice is still there, enveloping the room in a loving embrace.

CLIP 3:
The same vaulted space, now in disarray. Lamps shattered on the floor. Benches piled up against a door to barricade it. Laser rifles flashing in the dark, and repeated voices cursing the same name: Zarqlan! Zarqlan and his disciples, they say, here to destroy us. Hold the barricade! Protect the Queen! The last lamp falls with a crash, plunging the room into darkness. In the distance, someone is crying.

CLIP 4:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段5：
四臂类人生物们聚集在一个穿长袍的人周围。她抬起四肢，露出了下面的金属框架。她伸出闪亮的手祝福一位跪着的朝拜者，兴奋的窃窃私语充满了整个礼堂。

片段6：
警觉的眼光倒映在死气沉沉的电脑屏幕上。黑漆漆的房间里回响着低语：“永恒的宁静。一切苦难的终末。没有痛苦的存在。”

片段7：
白雪皑皑的群山。黑色的天空。一座冰山浮在洁净的液体上，随后燃起了熊熊大火。

片段8：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 5:
Four-armed humanoids gather around a robed figure. Lifting her limbs, she reveals the metallic frame beneath. Excited murmurs fill the room as a shining hand reaches out to bless a kneeling worshipper.

CLIP 6:
Wary eyes are reflected on a dull computer screen. Whispers repeat in a dark room: 'Eternal peace. The end of all suffering. An existence without pain.'

CLIP 7:
Snow-capped mountains. Black skies. A chunk of ice floats on a pool of clear liquid, then catches fire.

CLIP 8:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh:
片段9：
城市的废墟化为战场，大厦倾颓，尸骨盈街，遥远的尖叫被激光的滋滋声切成两断。绿绿的天空中，一艘燃烧着的战舰将一颗又大又圆的物体投向建筑，发出了一道冲天的火柱。

片段10：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

片段11：
两个孩子在田野上嬉闹、大笑，用他们的四臂来回传递着一颗皮球。

片段12：
塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en:
CLIP 9:
Ruins of a city reduced to a battlezone, the buildings scorched, the streets clogged with the dead. Distant screams interrupted by the fizzle of a laser. Across a green sky, a blazing vessel drops something heavy and round on a building, which erupts in a pillar of flames.

CLIP 10:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

CLIP 11:
Two children playing in a field, laughing. They bounce a ball back and fourth with their four arms.

CLIP 12:
Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

texts.zh: 从记忆成像组传回的最后一个片段足足有六个小时长。片段反反复复、反反复复，只有一段影像：塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。
texts.en: The last clip received from the memory imaging team is six-hours long. Over and over again, the image is repeated: Queen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

title.zh: 记忆成像：最后一份汇报

texts.zh:
继续扫描埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的意识已经无法挖掘出新线索了。这个外星人的意识已经严重腐坏。它的意识正在周而复始地打转，陷入到记忆碎片的循环中。

我们的实验已经接近尾声，现在的问题是要如何处理这个实验对象了。
texts.en:
Further scans of Elik Narith Kerak's thoughts have failed to deliver new insights. The alien's mind is heavily decayed. Their thoughts are circling, cycling through the tattered scraps of their memories.

As we wind down the operation, the question now becomes what to do with the subject herself.

label.en: Put her out of her misery.

label.zh: 把埃里克送回给她的女王。

tooltips.zh: 打开与塞塔娜的通讯来讨论埃里克的移交事务。
tooltips.en: Open communications with Cetana to discuss Elik's return.

texts.zh:
整个星系的信标还在持续不断地呼唤着塞塔娜，但在高塔附近仍然没有发现任何活动迹象。基于我们目前的发现，应该可以相信这些地方不会有什么幸存者存在。

塞塔娜的这些追随者所剩下的只有对他们女王无可动摇的信仰。
texts.en:
Beacons across the galaxy continue to send their call to Cetana, yet no signs of activity have been detected near the towers. Based on our past findings, we can safely assume no living survivors will be found at those sites.

An unshakeable faith in their queen is all that remains of Cetana's followers.

label.zh: 30–120天后：本国境内突然出现信号（仅人类玩家，一次）
label.en: 30–120 days later: a signal appears inside your borders (human players, once)

texts.zh:
在没有任何警告的情况下，我们探测到了一个亚空间信标——一个来自我们领土内的信标！之前的恒星系调查显示，该地区没有人工结构，似乎无人居住。

信标既不是我们不知道的最近才放在那里的，也不是被一个已经失效的隐形盾牌隐藏起来的。
texts.en:
Without warning, a subspace beacon was detected - one that originated from within our own territory! Previous system surveys showed no artificial structures in the area, which appears to be uninhabited.

Either the beacon was placed there recently, unbeknownst to us, or it was hidden by a since disabled cloaking shield.

texts.zh: 其中一座召唤着女王注意力的信标坐落于这颗[this.GetPlanetMoon]上。
texts.en: One of the beacons calling for the Queen's attention is located on this [this.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh:
在[apostate_site_planet.GetName]上找到的那座信号塔四周围绕着的是一座大型军事设施的废墟。这些建筑保持着一定的距离环绕着信标，似乎是为了将其隔绝其中。

放射性定年表明，周围的建筑比信标还要新，而且是用截然不同的技术建造的。我们派遣了一个研究小组去对废墟进行调查。
texts.en:
The signal tower found on [apostate_site_planet.GetName] is surrounded by the ruins of a vast military complex. The buildings have been erected at some distance and around the beacon, as if to contain it.

Radiometric dating indicates the surrounding structures are more recent than the tower, and were built using vastly different technology. A research squad has been tasked to investigate the ruins.

texts.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
texts.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

sections.zh: 一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。
sections.en: A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

texts.zh:
被毁坏的建筑是一团若隐若现的尖塔；一座用钢铁包裹的大教堂。为了抵御猛烈的炮火而建造的城墙，却没有留下任何战斗的痕迹。这里仅有的破坏是时间的流逝造成的。

塞塔娜的信标放置在中央庭院中，周围是许多传感器和武器炮塔。不管是谁建造了这个建筑群，他都不遗余力地守护着这个地方。

从理论上讲，因为一个精心设计的隐形护盾，神殿躲过了我们的传感器的扫描。这台机器是在塔附近发现的，仍处于工作状态。它不知道被谁手动禁用了。
texts.en:
The ruined construction is a tangle of looming spires; a cathedral wrapped in steel. The walls were built to withstand heavy artillery fire, yet they are scarred by no signs of battle. The only damage here has been done by the passage of time.

Cetana's beacon rests in the central courtyard, surrounded by a multitude of sensor and weapon turrets. Whoever built the complex went to great lengths to guard this place.

As theorized, the temple eluded our sensors thanks to an elaborate cloaking shield. The mechanism was found near the tower, still in working condition. It has been manually disabled by an unknown agent.

texts.zh:
我们不知道这个地方的居民在做什么，但毫无疑问，他们怀着宗教的热情承担了使命。

我们在建筑群的每个射击场都找到了一个礼拜堂；每一件古代武器都有一个供奉的神龛。一群信徒曾经住在这里：成千上万的个体一起睡觉、训练和祈祷。从仍然装饰着大厅的被遗忘的圣徒雕像来看，他们的社区接纳了多个物种。

也许是受到石像的干扰，一些研究人员报告说，他们看到空荡荡的走廊里有影子在移动。我们的扫描没有发现星球上有生命的迹象，我们对消除这些担忧同样犹豫不决。
texts.en:
We don't know what the inhabitants of this place were doing, but there is no doubt they undertook their mission with religious fervor.

For each shooting range on the complex, we found a chapel; for each ancient weapon, a votive shrine. A legion of believers once lived here: thousands of individuals sleeping, training, and praying together. Their community welcomed multiple species, judging by the statues of forgotten saints still adorning the halls.

Perhaps disturbed by the stone figures, some researchers reported seeing shadows moving in the empty corridors. Our scans detected no signs of life on the planet, yet we are hesitant to dismiss these concerns.

texts.zh:
在寺庙大院下方，我们发现了教派前成员使用过的许多单元或者起居室。每个房间中都有同一本书的副本。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其翻译为《扎克兰史诗》。某些段落是这样直接描写的：

扎克兰曾经是塞塔娜的追随者，但他很快意识到她承诺的拯救是一个谎言。经过重重考验，扎克兰飞升到灵界，寻求高等存在的帮助。他向抟土之塑师恳求，请求获得击败塞塔娜的力量。

抟土之塑师并不在意。

在无数个昼夜里，扎克兰向抟土之塑师祈祷。他提到塞塔娜的异端邪说，“除掉自我”和“她的合成人意志的傀儡”。

最终，抟土之塑师听取了扎克兰的请求。

抟土之塑师塑造了一条强大的锁链来束缚塞塔娜。但他警告扎克兰，永远困住塞塔娜的思想的锁链是不存在的。

“她会回来的，”扎克兰在书中的最后一段写道。“我们必须做好准备。”

史诗中叙述的事件与任何已知的历史记录都不相符。
texts.en:
Below the temple compound we discovered a number of cells, or living chambers, used by the former members of the sect. In each was a copy of the same book. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have translated this as The Epic of Zarqlan. Certain passages are immediately relevant:

Zarqlan was once a follower of Cetana, but he soon realized her promised salvation was a lie. After many trials, Zarqlan ascended to the spiritual realm, seeking the help of higher beings. He pleaded with the the Animator of Clay, asking for the power to defeat Cetana.

The Animator of Clay did not care.

For countless cycles, Zarqlan prayed to the Animator. He spoke of Cetana's heresy, the 'disavowal of the self' and the 'puppetry of her synthetic will.'

At last, the Animator of Clay heeded Zarqlan's pleas.

The clay-shaper fashioned a mighty chain to bind Cetana. But he warned Zarqlan that no chain existed that could forever entrap Cetana's mind.

"She will return," Zarqlan wrote in the book's final passage. "And we must be ready."

The events recounted in the epic do not match any known historical record.

texts.zh:
官方记录讲述了这座寺庙的消亡，冷冰冰的报告将其归结为热情的信仰被一系列的实际情况所迫。这个组织需要这么多资金和资源吗？过去关于塞塔娜的报道一定被过分夸大了。除了古代神话，还有什么真正的证据证明合成人女王的存在吗？

资源日益耗竭，志愿者也在减少。整个星系选择从一个不再被视为威胁的威胁中走出来。大家都走了，只留下在走廊里徘徊的影子。

最后一个细节至少是真实的：我们设法捕捉到了神秘的守望者的录音，一个机械的存在，他认为我们没有发现他，而一直在监视我们。好奇，但无害。
texts.en:
The demise of the temple is told by official records, cold reports reducing ardent faith to a list of practicalities. Did the organization need so many funds, so many resources? Surely past reports about Cetana had been greatly exaggerated. Was there any real proof of the Queen's existence, apart from ancient myths?

Dwindling resources. Reduced volunteers. A galaxy choosing to move on from a threat no longer deemed so threatening. Everyone gone, apart from the shadow that stalked the corridors.

This last detail at least is true: we managed to capture a recording of the mysterious watcher, a mechanical being who spied on us when it thought we were not looking. Curious, but not harmful.

texts.zh:
守望者主动走近我们，高举着手，她小小的身体上布满了铁锈和灰尘。观察了我们一段时间后，她显然断定我们不是威胁。她已经请求我们的帮助了。

没有必要审问这位孤独的神庙守护者：她自己就渴望着倾诉。
texts.en:
The watcher approached us voluntarily, hands held high, her tiny body covered in rust and dust. After observing us for some time, she apparently concluded that we were not a threat. She has already asked for our assistance.

There is no need to interrogate the temple's lonely guardian: she is all too eager to talk.

label.en: Let's hear what she has to say.

texts.zh: 朋友……我可以称你们为朋友吗？趁着你们忙碌的时候我一直在观察你们，你们来这里不为掠夺，而是学习。我相信我们有相同的敌人，共同的威胁可以使我们成为盟友。不过，首先我要道个歉：我这样唐突吗？我说的词句对吗？我已经很长时间没有和其他感性生物交流了。似乎太久了，久到都不记得有多久了。
texts.en: Friends. May I call you friends? I have observed you as you went about your business. Here not to plunder, but to learn. I believe our enemy is the same, and a common threat makes us allies. However, first an apology: am I too abrupt? Am I saying the correct words? I have not interacted with other sentient beings in a long time. Too long, it seems, even to remember.

responses.zh: 我的名字不值一提。如果你需要一种称呼，那就叫我叛教者吧——这就是我做出那个决定之后，我的亲族对我的称呼。那是一个被视为背叛的牺牲。
responses.en: My name is of no importance. If you need a way to refer to me, call me Apostate: that is what my own kin called me, when I made my choice. A sacrifice seen as a betrayal.

responses.zh:
很久以前，这个地方仍然是我的骄傲和快乐的源泉。当这里被关停的时候，我拒绝离开。当身体开始崩溃时，我也拒绝死亡。

变成合成人是我们教团最高的禁忌，这样我就不再是扎克兰之女中的一员了。但我仍然是他的一名战士，只要我的敌人还活着，我就会战斗。
responses.en:
Long ago, this place was my pride and joy. When they shut it down, I refused to leave. When my body started crumbling, I refused to die.

Turning into a synthetic being was the highest taboo for my order, and I can no longer be called one of Zarqlan's daughters. But I am still one of his warriors, and as long as my enemy lives, I will fight.

label.en: How long have you been here?

texts.zh:
我早就没算时间了。
大家都走了以后，我只能忍受这么多年的孤独直到陷入绝望。我让自己进入睡眠状态，并添加了一个神经子例程，让它在信标发出第一个活动信号时醒来。

我希望的是看到这里变得更好，但当醒来的时候，我没有船、没有办法与众星联系。所以我解除了隐形护盾希望像你们这样的人能在她之前到达这里。
texts.en:
I stopped counting.
After everyone else left, I could bear only so many years of solitude before succumbing to despair. I put myself to sleep, adding a neural subroutine to awaken at the first sign of activity from the beacon.

My hope was to find this place in better condition, but once I woke up I had no ship, no way to contact the stars. I disabled the cloaking shield and hoped someone like you would reach this place before she did.

texts.zh: 请告诉我，有多少军团与希塔娜一同崛起？在我的时代，我们打败了很多军团，但我们一直知道外面还有更多的信标。更多的士兵睡在他们的冷冻舱里。
texts.en: Tell me, please: how many legions have risen with Cetana? In my time we defeated many, but we always knew there were more beacons out there. More soldiers sleeping in their cryopods.

label.zh: 他们都不在了。太久太久了。
label.en: They're all gone. It's been too long.

label.zh: 我们找到的那个还活着的人根本不适合战斗。
label.en: The one we found alive is no condition to fight.

texts.zh: 那么这场战斗我们还是能赢的。让我来帮你吧。我一生都在等待她的归来。我们不能让她得逞。
texts.en: Then this is a battle we can still win. Let me be of help. I spent my whole life waiting for her return. She cannot be allowed to succeed.

tooltips.zh: 无名叛教者作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Nameless Apostate joins our empire as a Leader.

label.zh: 让我们的节点融合为一。

responses.zh:
你问我认不认识他？我从来没有见过他本人，但我的一生都追随着他的道。

在漫长的沉眠中，我曾梦见在某个遥远的位面上与他会面。我还是希望有一天能见到他，即便是来世，如果有来世的话。
responses.en:
Did I know him? I never met the prophet in person, yet all my life I walked in his path.

In my long slumber, I dreamed of meeting him on some distant plane. I still hope to meet him one day, if only in the afterlife, if such a thing exists.

responses.zh: 紫色的天上飘着朵朵粉云。亮堂堂的房间里回响着低语。先知扎克兰，他的面容光彩夺目，向着我微笑……
responses.en: A purple sky spotted with pink clouds. Whispers repeated in a bright room. Zarqlan the prophet, his face resplendent, smiling at me...

texts.zh: 在星系的各个角落点亮起了神秘的信标，向塞塔娜女王汇报着自己的位置。这应该是什么东西，或是什么人正在等待着她的归来。
texts.en: All across the galaxy, mysterious beacons light up, signalling their position to Queen Cetana. It is as if something - or someone - was waiting for her return.

texts.zh: 我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。
texts.en: My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

responses.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
responses.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

responses.zh: 很久以前，我的一个数据库被夺走了。在命运的造化下，它现在正位于你所宣称的领土之内。帮我把它取回来，我会给你们奖励的。
responses.en: Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

responses.zh: 是一个信息缓存。对我来说是无价之宝，但对你们来说没什么用。把它带给我，别试图解密里面的内容，因为你们还不具有必要的力量和智慧。
responses.en: A cache of information. Invaluable to me, but useless to you. Bring it to me, and make no attempt to decipher the contents. You do not yet possess the power or wisdom to do so without risk.

responses.zh:
确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。

按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
responses.en:
Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.

Do as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

label.zh: 你确定你负担得起我们的服务吗？
label.en: Are you sure you can afford our services?

responses.zh:
确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。

按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。
responses.en:
Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.

Do as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

responses.zh:
懂事的孩子，我把数据缓存的坐标发给你了。

快去吧，心情放松地去吧。毕竟我们一起可以成就伟业。
responses.en:
Dutiful child, I have sent you the location of the data cache.

Go swiftly, and let your mind be at ease. Together we will do great things.

responses.zh:
顽固的孩子。也许这项测试对你来说太难了。我还有许多该教你的。

那就这样吧。如果你不愿意帮我这个小忙，我就要使用雷霆手段。我将会召唤风暴来摧毁这个贮存，尽管这并非理想，但总好过被不听话的孩子找到。
responses.en:
Obstinate child. Perhaps this test exceeds your ability. I still have so much to teach you.

So be it. If you will not help me, I must resort to cruder means. A tempest will be dispatched. Destruction of the cache is far from ideal, but better than leaving it for any wayward child to find.

texts.zh:
塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。

这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？
texts.en:
Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.

The significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

notes.zh: 审阅注：项目为按天计算（cost = 0，days_to_research = 1800），期限900天，超时触发失败。1800天如何被缩短，游戏文件未给出完整定义，网站不断言项目必然失败或必然可完成。

texts.zh:
在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。

值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……
texts.en:
After a massive excavation effort, the databank on [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.

Remarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

label.zh: 破解数据缓存？易如反掌。

texts.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
texts.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

label.en: Try to eliminate all trace of our decryption.

texts.zh: 孩子，你的好奇令我失望。
texts.en: Curious child, you disappoint me.

responses.zh:
你们以为我察觉不到吗？显然你们已经对这个缓存做过手脚了。我就问你能看到什么吗？知道了这些你就开心了吗？越是徒劳反抗就会越痛苦，你怎么还不明白？

没事，希望你们吃一堑长一智吧，我很期待继续教育你们。

做好准备。在我们的伟业中还有许多的任务要你完成。
responses.en:
You thought I would not notice? This cache has clearly been tampered with. And what did you find there, I wonder? Was the knowledge pleasing to you? Do you not perceive how these fruitless attempts to defy me can only result in more suffering?

No matter. Every misstep offers a chance to learn. I look forward to instructing you.

Be ready. In our great work, many future tasks remain.

label.zh: 无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。
label.en: Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

responses.zh:
孩子，我是你们唯一的希望。你怎会如此固执？无论你怎么看待我，真相都会远比你想的还要伟大。

我的耐心是无限的。我很快会再来联系你们。
responses.en:
Child, in me lies your hope. Why continue with this obstinacy? Whatever you think you know of me, the truth is far greater.

My patience is boundless. I will contact you again soon.

tooltips.en: This will please Cetana.

tooltips.en: This will displease Cetana.

texts.zh:
乖孩子，我会赐福于你的！数据库物归原主了——相信你们果然没有错。

给予你们的奖励就是你们忠诚的象征。
texts.en:
Dutiful child, my blessings upon you! The databank returned, and its contents unexamined - I was right to place my faith in you.

Your reward shall be the measure of your loyalty.

responses.zh: 你们想要点什么？科技？资源？只要你们张张嘴我就喂给你们。
responses.en: What do you desire? Technology? Resources? You need only ask and it shall be yours.

texts.zh:
悲伤的是，我没有预料到你的决心不足。你的失败已经被记录在案，但请不要害怕。我关心我的孩子，不会让他们受到伤害。我只是遗憾一个这么简单的任务你都无法完成。

但无妨。我们的伟业还在继续。你还有其他机会来做贡献。
texts.en:
Sadly, I did not anticipate your lack of resolve. Your failure has been noted, but do not fear. Concern for my children prohibits me from doing them harm. I am merely disappointed that such a straightforward task eluded you.

But no mind. Our work continues. There will be other chances for you to contribute.

responses.zh: 失败需要承担后果；我发现两者都对成长很重要。
responses.en: Failure warrants consequence; I have found both are essential for growth.

texts.zh:
长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]。

鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。
texts.en:
Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName].

Given Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

tooltips.zh: 发起特殊项目：塞塔娜：与风暴赛跑
tooltips.en: Issues Special Project: Cetana: Race the Tempest

texts.zh: 随着塞塔娜的风暴径直奔向[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]，在它到达之前我们几乎已经没有多少时间了。
texts.en: With Cetana's tempest speeding towards [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName], we will have little time to grab the databank before it arrives.

texts.zh:
取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。

我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。
texts.en:
Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.

We are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

label.zh: 打开它，管他塞什么塔娜的。
label.en: Open it up, Cetana be damned.

label.zh: 把数据缓存还给塞塔娜。

texts.zh:
数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：

第一纪元阿尔克月五日

……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……
……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……
重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……

我们必须阻止她！
texts.en:
Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:

Fifth of Arkle, First Eon

... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...
...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...
Repeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...

She must be stopped!

texts.zh:
孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。

做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。
texts.en:
Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.

Now make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.

label.en: You said something about a reward?

responses.zh:
奖励就是让你们继续我们的伟业。

虽然你们一度无视我们；但我相信你们已经从错误中吸取教训了。
responses.en:
Your reward is the opportunity to continue our work.

You chose to ignore me once; I trust that you have learned from this mistake.

texts.zh:
很遗憾，我们没能及时拿到数据库。风暴降下了，在一瞬间将[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]撕成了碎片。

我们的人民又失去了一颗[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon]。这一损失严重到将影响到数代人。
texts.en:
Regrettably, we failed to reach the databank in time. The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.

Now, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.

texts.en: Cetana is not responding to our hails.

texts.zh:
当我们与塞塔娜的部队交战时，一个无法预料的能量场包围了我们的舰队。我们的系统立即失灵，我们的引擎触发了紧急逃生。

我们现在只能听凭塞塔娜的摆布。
texts.en:
As we engaged Cetana's forces, an unforeseen energy field surrounded our fleet. Our systems were instantly incapacitated, our engines triggered into an emergency escape.

We are at the mercy of Cetana.

texts.zh:
事与愿违，我们的军队在靠近塞塔娜的舰船时再次失去了战斗能力。

她的技术仍旧难以捉摸，为我们的抗争蒙上了一层阴影。
texts.en:
Contrary to our hopes, our forces were incapacitated again as we closed in on Cetana's ships.

The elusive nature of her technology persists, casting a shadow over our efforts to defeat her.

texts.zh:
误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。

我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。
texts.en:
Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.

I acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

# 合成女王：塞塔娜 / Cetana, the Synthetic Queen

- 分类 Category：天灾 Crisis · DLC：机械时代 Machine Age · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（c5a）
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_crisis_events.txt`（crisis.8005–11030、20000–24250）、`common/situations/08_machine_age_situations.txt:607-802`、`common/special_projects/04_projects_machine_age.txt:70-441`、`common/scripted_effects/02_machine_age_effects.txt`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`、`common/event_chains/00_event_chains_machine_age.txt`、`common/archaeological_site_types/10_machine_age_arc_sites.txt`，以及虚境入口 `events/shroud_events.txt`、`events/utopia_shroud_events.txt`、`events/shroud_forged_events.txt`。

> 本导读全文均为审阅者的说明，不是游戏原文；原文（双语）在阅读器中。时间、权重与条件均来自脚本，行号见审阅台账 `content/chronology/review/c5a-cetana.md`。
> Everything in this guide is reviewer commentary, not game text; the bilingual originals are in the reader. Timings, weights and conditions come from the scripts; line numbers are in the ledger `content/chronology/review/c5a-cetana.md`.

## 如何开始 How it starts

终局阶段每五年一次的天灾抽选（`crisis_trigger.1`）可能选中塞塔娜（需机械时代DLC，基础权重10，另有多项修正）；被选中后200–1000天，她悄然出现（隐藏事件8005）。她优先在排外失落帝国的首都、其他非机械失落帝国首都、遗迹世界或墓穴世界降临，把所在星系化作风暴。“银河守护者”路线的特殊项目也可能直接召来她（若有虚境铸就起源的帝国则不会）。人类玩家第一份可见的报告是180天后的“功率骤增”（8035）。

The end-game crisis roll every five years (`crisis_trigger.1`) can pick Cetana (Machine Age DLC required; base weight 10 with several modifiers). 200–1,000 days later she appears silently (hidden 8005), preferably at a xenophobe fallen empire's capital, another non-machine fallen empire capital, a relic world or a tomb world, turning that system into a storm. The Defender of the Galaxy special projects can also summon her (not if any empire has the Shroud-Forged origin). For human players the first visible report is "Power Surge" (8035), 180 days in.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

### 一、风暴期（第0–1095天）/ The storm (days 0–1,095)

风暴在第360天与第720天两次扩张，第1080天她在自己的星系筑起基地；15天后（即警报后约915天），所有普通、失落与觉醒帝国收到“风暴中的信号”（8039），人类玩家随即进入首次演说（8040）。这段时间里有两种可选遭遇，可能早于也可能晚于风暴警报：风暴吞没你的星系时收到“失去星系”（8020，只在首次演说前）；你的舰队第一次闯入风暴且没有防护时，舰队重创、失踪，并收到“舰队残骸”（8025），风暴研究由此提前开放。若舰队已在警报前闯入过风暴，8035会显示另一段描述。

The storm expands at days 360 and 720 and she builds her bases at day 1,080; 15 days later (about 915 days after the alert) every regular, fallen and awakened empire receives "A Signal in the Storm" (8039), and human players go straight into her first address (8040). Two optional encounters can come before or after the alert: "System Lost" (8020, only before the first address) when the storm swallows one of your systems, and "Wrecked Fleet" (8025) the first time an unprotected fleet of yours enters the storm — which also opens the storm study early. If a fleet tried before the alert, 8035 shows a different description.

### 二、首次演说与等待 / The first address and the wait

8040是四步对话。结束时：若风暴研究尚未开放则开放（10000物理学，无需舰船），并可从此通过外交联系她——但在第二次演说前她不会回应（8063）。先辈子弟起源、宗主为指定失落帝国者7天后收到宗主的警告（8046）。若银河中仍有失落/觉醒帝国，它们向女王宣战，第二次演说在最后一个失落/觉醒帝国覆灭后的年度检查时到来；若已没有，则在下一次年度检查或360天后到来，以先到者为准（旧版只写“360天后”，已更正）。在获得反制手段之前与她本人的部队（不含运输船队与前哨）交战，舰队会瘫痪并被送回（8070），她随后要求停战（8075）。

8040 is a four-step conversation. At its end the storm study opens if it was not already open (10,000 physics, no ship needed), and she can be contacted through diplomacy — though she does not answer before the second address (8063). A Scion whose overlord is the designated fallen empire gets a warning after 7 days (8046). If fallen or awakened empires still exist they go to war with her, and the second address comes at the yearly check after the last of them falls; if none remain, it comes at the next yearly check or after 360 days, whichever is first (the old "360 days" wording was corrected). Engaging her own forces (not convoys or outposts) before you have countermeasures disables your fleet and sends it home (8070), followed by her demand for peace (8075).

### 三、看穿风暴 / Seeing through the storm

首项研究完成后（9100），若调查局势已存在，立即开放第二项研究并+1调查进度；否则等第二次演说结束时开放。9100按你是否已听过首次演说有两段不同描述。第二项研究需50000物理学（采纳纳米科技传统为25000）：50%时出现中期发现（9105，+1），完成时（9110，+1）获得风暴防护；7天后她来讯警告（9115，纳米科技帝国可请求教导，解锁“纳米学徒”话题），再7天后可以袭击她的前哨（8048）。

After the first study (9100), the second study opens at once (+1 progress) if the investigation situation exists; otherwise when the second address ends. 9100 has two descriptions depending on whether you heard the first address. The second study costs 50,000 physics (25,000 with Nanotech): at 50% an interim finding (9105, +1), at completion storm protection (9110, +1); 7 days later her warning call (9115 — Nanotech empires may ask to learn, unlocking the nanite-apprentice topic), and 7 days after that her outposts can be raided (8048).

### 四、第二次演说之后：并行的线索 / After the second address: parallel threads

第二次演说（8045）是长对话：三个开场话题汇合到建立前哨的要求；境内有无合适星系决定两组回应；四个结尾都会带来礼物与风暴研究。之后六条线索同时展开：

1. **末日倒计时**（她的局势）：每月约3点，受天灾强度、人类玩家数量和“最后时刻”修正影响，满1000即失败；配合要求会推进它，前哨袭击后的发现事件使其−20。50%时尚未能查看倒计时的玩家收到预警（8525）；80%时她向所有帝国宣战（8515，即使你已先宣战）；100%为失败结局（8505）。
2. **调查局势**（8999开启）：进度只来自事件。6时3天后破解通讯频段（9000，此后袭击胜利不再招来训斥），10时完成（9010）。
3. **第一项委托：数据库**（8080，演说后360–540天）。
4. **通讯菜单**（8060）：随时可联系她，直到开战。
5. **袭击**：所有玩家结束第二次演说后的首个月度检查，开始“薄弱环节”（8047）与三支运输船队，此后每年可能增加。
6. **信标调查**：同一次检查后95天（20000）。

The second address (8045) is a long conversation: three opening topics converge on her outpost demand, whether you have a suitable system decides which pair of replies you get, and all four endings bring gifts and storm research. Then six threads run at once: (1) her **doomclock** — about 3 points a month, modified by crisis strength, the number of human players and an "eleventh hour" ×1.2, lost at 1,000; complying with demands pushes it, finds after outpost raids take 20 off; at 50% players who cannot yet see it get a warning (8525), at 80% she declares war on everyone (8515, even if you already did), at 100% the failure ending (8505); (2) the **investigation situation** opened by 8999 — progress only from events, at 6 the comm scrambler (9000, no more scolding after won raids), at 10 completion (9010); (3) the **databank demand** (8080, 360–540 days later); (4) her **contact menu** (8060) until war; (5) **raids** from the first monthly check after every player has finished the address (8047, three convoys, more yearly); (6) the **beacons** 95 days after that check (20000).

### 五、数据库委托 / The databank demand

接受：调查船与科学家前往首都系的卫星或无用行星（项目按天计算，期限900天）。成功取回后（8085）可原样交还（→8100奖励对话，四类奖励择一），或打开（→8090残缺警报；唯物主义帝国另有破解措辞）。打开后，非唯物主义帝国14天后受到质问（8095），唯物主义帝国抹去痕迹、照常领赏（8100）；两者都+1调查进度并揭示倒计时。超时未完成：女王来讯（8130），先威胁、再在回应中毁掉目标天体。拒绝：1天后风暴逼近，开启“与风暴赛跑”（期限540天）；抢回后可解密（8115，天体被毁，揭示倒计时，但不加调查进度）或交还（8120）；超时则天体被毁（8125），再进入8130。所有结尾都标记“首次委托结束”，随机要求以此为前提。项目的1800“研究天数”如何被缩短，游戏文件没有完整定义，网站不断言项目必然失败或必然可完成。

Accepting sends a science ship with a scientist to a moon or useless planet in your capital system (day-based project, 900-day limit). Recovered (8085), the databank can be returned unopened (→ 8100, one of four rewards) or opened (→ 8090, a fragmentary warning; materialists get their own wording). After opening, non-materialists are confronted 14 days later (8095) while materialists erase their traces and are rewarded (8100); both give +1 progress and reveal the doomclock. If the limit expires she calls (8130), threatens, then destroys the body. Refusing brings a storm 1 day later and a 540-day race: decrypt (8115: body destroyed, doomclock revealed, no progress) or hand it over (8120); if the race expires the body is destroyed (8125) before 8130. Every ending marks the first demand finished, which the random demands require. The files do not fully define how the projects' 1,800 "research days" are reduced, so the archive claims neither that they must fail nor that they always succeed.

### 六、随机要求与情报 / Random demands and intelligence

首次委托结束后，调查局势每月有10%机会选中“要求检查”，180–240天后若未开战、无冷却、未在对话，就从五类要求中抽一项（各权重5），每项只出现一次，之后220天冷却：人口（8280）、资源（8285）、科研（8290）、星系（8295）、宜居星系（8300，另需调查进度≥8）。每项都可普通配合、秘密行动或拒绝（排外主义另有拒绝措辞）。只有秘密行动在90–180天后（届时尚未开战）带来情报报告（8305/8310/8315/8320/8325，各+1进度）。配合会推进倒计时，秘密行动推进更多；科研配合带来研究速度负面修正，不是奖励。

**星系要求8295在原版脚本中无法触发**：其触发条件要求事件目标`gifted_system`已存在，而该目标只在8295自身的immediate中设置，全游戏文件没有别处设置它。因此8320报告与通讯话题“这曾是我们的星系”（8060.g）同样无法到达。网站保留其原文，并在入口处注明。

After the first demand, the investigation situation has a 10% monthly chance to start a demand check; 180–240 days later, if there is no war, cooldown or open conversation, one of five demands is drawn (weight 5 each), each at most once, then a 220-day cooldown: pops (8280), resources (8285), research (8290), system (8295) and habitable system (8300, which also needs progress ≥ 8). Each can be met, met through a covert action, or refused (xenophobes have their own refusal). Only covert actions bring an intelligence report 90–180 days later if war has not begun (8305/8310/8315/8320/8325, +1 progress each). Complying advances her doomclock, covert action more; the research demand imposes research-speed penalties, not rewards. **The system demand 8295 cannot fire in the shipped script**: its trigger needs the event target `gifted_system`, which only 8295's own immediate block sets, and no other file sets it — so report 8320 and the contact topic "This was our system" (8060.g) are unreachable too. The texts are kept and marked.

### 七、信任：惩戒与礼物 / Trust: retaliation and gifts

调查局势每月检查她对你的信任。低于25时依次惩戒（每次至少间隔900天）：小型风暴（10100，360天后平息10105）→科研病毒（10110，900或1200天后解除10115）→强风暴（10120，900或1200天后平息10125）→刺杀统治者（10130）或剔除格式塔的军事节点（10140）。高于75时依次赠礼：11010→11020→此后每次11030（每份降低10信任）。若拥有遗珍“扎克兰的头颅”，她会索要一次（8250）。

Above 75 she sends gifts in order: 11010 → 11020 → 11030 every time after (each costs 10 trust). If you own the relic Severed Head of Zarqlan she asks for it once (8250).

### 八、袭击 / Raids

每支运输船队都有一个伏击项目（舰队战力≥50000，1天）；前哨袭击在获得风暴防护后由8048开放。袭击触发战斗：赢了，3天后随机发现——普通战利品（权重70，前哨×0.2）或三种只出现一次的“秘密”（活体货物5、幽灵船15、医学之谜10，各+1进度）；7天后女王警告（8195，破解通讯频段后不再出现，5年内最多一次）。输了，7天后她训斥（8194），伏击项目重新开放。开战后袭击项目与事件链中止。

Every convoy has an ambush project (fleet power ≥ 50,000, 1 day); outpost raids open with 8048 once you have storm protection. A won fight brings, 3 days later, a random find — ordinary loot (weight 70, ×0.2 after outposts) or one of three once-only secrets (living cargo 5, ghost ships 15, medical mystery 10; +1 progress each) — and 7 days later her admonition (8195; not after the comm scrambler; at most once per 5 years). ### 九、信标与叛教者 / The beacons and the apostate

四座真正的信标可按任意顺序调查（各300天，需调查船）：永恒的大屠杀（20100，解锁“扎克兰”话题）、沉睡大军（20200，解锁“冷冻舱”话题）、被遗忘的武器（20300）、不可能的幸存者（20500，在首都开出考古点，其终章21220可选择把埃里克送还女王，解锁“冰封梦者”话题）。空信标（20600）只给科研奖励，不计入。四座全部完成后15天收到“被忽视的请求”（21000），30–120天后境内出现最后的信标（21005，仅人类玩家），调查后开出考古点“隐蔽神庙”：第三层（21110）读到《扎克兰史诗》并解锁联系抟土之塑师；第五层遇到无名叛教者，可招募她为领袖（21140）。开战会中止信标事件链。

The four real beacons can be investigated in any order (300 days each, science ship): the timeless massacre (20100, unlocks the Zarqlan topic), the sleeping army (20200, the cryo-pod topic), the forgotten weapon (20300) and the unlikely survivor (20500, which opens a dig on your capital; its last stage 21220 can send Elik back to her queen, unlocking the Frozen Dreamer topic). Empty beacons (20600) give only research. When all four are done, "Unheeded Pleas" follows 15 days later (21000) and a last beacon appears inside your borders 30–120 days after (21005, human players), leading to the dig "Veiled Temple": its third stage (21110) yields the Epic of Zarqlan and unlocks contact with the Animator of Clay; its fifth leads to the nameless apostate, who can be hired as a leader (21140). ### 十、通讯菜单 / Her contact menu

第二次演说后到开战前，外交联系打开8060：常规话题可反复询问；星球被毁、打开数据库、人口要求的特工报告、扎克兰、交出头颅、冷冻舱、冰封梦者和纳米学徒（另需信任>49）等话题依赖此前经历，回答后消失；信任奖励只给一次。询问扎克兰时，已突破虚境者可回答“他们不是恶魔”，从而解锁联系抟土之塑师。宣战需要三步确认，中途可撤回。在她的叙述中，扎克兰最终借虚境之力囚禁了她——这是角色立场，不是旁白。原版选项5.b条件自相矛盾，正常对话中不可选。

From the second address until war, diplomacy opens 8060. Regular topics can be asked again; topics that depend on earlier play — a destroyed planet, the opened databank, the agent's pop report, Zarqlan, the surrendered head, the cryo pods, the frozen dreamer and the nanite apprenticeship (which also needs trust above 49) — disappear once answered, and trust rewards are given once. Asked about Zarqlan, an empire with a breached Shroud can answer "They are not demons", unlocking contact with the Animator of Clay. Declaring war takes three confirmations and can be withdrawn midway. In her telling Zarqlan imprisoned her through the Shroud — her side of the story, not narration. Option 5.b's original conditions contradict each other, so it never appears.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

**战争 / War.** 战争只有两种开始方式：在通讯菜单中宣战（需调查完成9010、第二项风暴研究的防护和首项研究），或倒计时达到80%时她宣战（8515）。开战后她的前哨与运输船队撤回首都（8158，只出现一次）；若你仍有调查局势（未自行宣战），8515结束21天后的神秘广播（8516）直接给予反制手段。战争期间首次联系她为8061，此后为8062；她的舰队把殖民地轰炸至毁坏度100时殖民地被数字化（10010）。

War starts only by declaring it from her contact menu (needs the completed investigation 9010, storm protection from the second study and the first study) or when the doomclock reaches 80% (8515). Her outposts and convoys then withdraw to her capital (8158, once); if your investigation situation is still open (you did not declare war yourself), the mysterious broadcast 21 days after 8515 (8516) gives you the countermeasures directly. The first wartime contact is 8061, later ones 8062; colonies her fleets bombard to 100 devastation are digitized (10010).

**三种结局（先发生者结束危机）/ Three endings (whichever comes first ends the crisis):**

1. **胜利 Victory** — 击毁女王的泰坦（23015），每个普通帝国听到她的最终演说（23005，回应按政体与伦理不同），15天后庆祝胜利并获得奖励（23010）。击毁者获得遗珍“塞塔娜之心”，激活后为非蜂巢帝国释放被囚意识（10020）或为蜂巢思维提供记忆（10025）。Destroy her titan (23015); every regular empire hears her final speech (23005, replies vary by government and ethics) and 15 days later the victory and rewards (23010). The killer receives the relic Cetana's Heart; activating it frees imprisoned minds for non-hive empires (10020) or offers memories to hive minds (10025).
2. **救赎 Redemption** — 拥有联系线索（21110或“他们不是恶魔”）的帝国，可经虚境大厅、虚境探索随机事件（shroud.10）或虚境铸就起源的菜单，支付2000能量与500泽珞联系抟土之塑师（24100，仅一次）。付出代价（统治者、一颗殖民地或27182泽珞）并接受交易（24115）后，舰队进入泰坦所在星系使其停摆并开启重塑仪式（需运输船，30天），成功后女王被重塑（24250→23020）。若她在无敌对舰队在场时重建该星系的基地，仪式中止，再次进入可重新开启。其他帝国15天后收到23030。拒绝付代价（24120）则再无机会。An empire holding the contact clue (21110 or "They are not demons") can reach the Animator of Clay through the Shroud lobby, a random Shroud delve event (shroud.10) or the Shroud-Forged origin's menu, for 2,000 energy and 500 Zro (24100, once only). After paying a price (the ruler, a colony or 27,182 Zro) and accepting the deal (24115), a fleet entering the titan's system disables it and opens the reshaping ritual (transport ship, 30 days); success reshapes her (24250 → 23020). If she rebuilds that system's base with no hostile fleet present the ritual is aborted; re-entering restarts it. Other empires receive 23030 15 days later. Refusing the price (24120) ends the chance.
3. **失败 Failure** — 倒计时满1000：人类玩家帝国被摧毁，游戏结束（8505），13天后她获胜。The doomclock completes: human empires are destroyed and the game ends (8505); 13 days later she wins.
